title: Who Signs Off
description: Anthropic's Claude Ship (vendor) splits post-PR work into a reviewer, a steward that can fix but never approve or merge, and a repo policy file that decides who must approve, with frank docs on every way a change can merge with nobody looking. Plus: Juraj Blahunka's overnight run where the model worked only 26% of the time, MONEI on GitHub webhooks that arrive late, twice or never, Evil Martians on whether types help agents, Datadog's Ephyra finding 535 bugs with agent-written test generators, Dex Horthy's 12 rules for a factory that doesn't ship slop, and 'The Pull Request Is Dead'. Practical idea: an approval policy file for Andrew's factory, run in observe mode first.
